_comment: Aftershock curated GraphSchema for the FalkorDB docs corpus (SYSTEM_DESIGN.md §7.1). Loaded as graphrag_sdk.Ontology via Ontology.model_validate_json(). Started from the SDK's ontology *discovery* output on a page sample, then hand-curated: merged near-duplicate proposed types, fixed relation directions, and added RELATED_TO as a deliberate catch-all so prose that doesn't fit a strict type is still captured instead of dropped. Entity ids are deterministic (name__type, lowercased/snake-cased) per graphrag_sdk.ingestion.extraction_strategies.entity_extractors.compute_entity_id — that's what makes a fact_key stable across GRAPH.COPY'd graphs (§6.2).

entities.label: Product
entities.description: A top-level FalkorDB product or surface: FalkorDB (core), FalkorDB Cloud, FalkorDB Enterprise, the GraphRAG SDK, or the Browser UI.

entities.label: Command
entities.description: A Redis-protocol command the FalkorDB module exposes, e.g. GRAPH.QUERY, GRAPH.RO_QUERY, GRAPH.COPY, GRAPH.CONFIG SET.

properties.name: since_version
properties.description: First version the command was available in, if the docs state it.

entities.label: CypherFeature
entities.description: An openCypher clause, function, or syntax feature FalkorDB implements or explicitly does not implement (e.g. MATCH, any(), list comprehension, UNWIND of maps).

entities.label: Algorithm
entities.description: A built-in graph algorithm, e.g. PageRank, weakly connected components, shortest path.

entities.label: ConfigParameter
entities.description: A GRAPH.CONFIG parameter, e.g. MAX_QUEUED_QUERIES, TIMEOUT, RESULTSET_SIZE.

entities.label: ClientLibrary
entities.description: An official client library for a specific language, e.g. the Python, Node.js, Java, or Go client.

entities.label: Integration
entities.description: A third-party system or framework FalkorDB integrates with, e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, LiteLLM.

entities.label: APIClass
entities.description: A named class or entry point in the GraphRAG SDK's Python API, e.g. GraphRAG, Ontology, GraphSchema (legacy), KnowledgeGraph (legacy), Entity, Relation, EntityType (legacy).

entities.label: Concept
entities.description: A technical concept or abstraction that isn't one of the more specific types above, e.g. multi-tenancy, vector index, full-text index, ontology discovery, abstention.

entities.label: Limitation
entities.description: A documented constraint, unsupported feature, or known gap.

entities.label: Version
entities.description: A released version or version range of a product, e.g. FalkorDB v1.2, GraphRAG SDK v1.4.0.

relations.label: SUPPORTS
relations.description: The source provides or enables the target.

relations.label: REQUIRES
relations.description: The source cannot be used without the target.

relations.label: REPLACED_BY
relations.description: The source is superseded by the target (a renamed class, a deprecated command, a new default). The single most important edge type for impact analysis: this is exactly what PR #479 created when it rewrote KnowledgeGraph -> GraphRAG.

relations.label: DEPRECATED_IN
relations.description: The source was marked deprecated as of the target version.

relations.label: INTRODUCED_IN
relations.description: The source first became available in the target version.

relations.label: HAS_PARAMETER
relations.description: The source command or class accepts the target configuration parameter.

relations.label: HAS_DEFAULT
relations.description: The source parameter's documented default behavior or value, described as a concept when it isn't a bare literal.

relations.label: PART_OF_PRODUCT
relations.description: The source ships as part of the target product.

relations.label: INTEGRATES_WITH
relations.description: The source and target interoperate (bidirectional in practice; extracted in whichever direction the text states it).

relations.label: LIMITED_BY
relations.description: The source is constrained by the target documented limitation.

relations.label: CONFIGURED_BY
relations.description: The source's behavior is controlled by the target configuration parameter.

relations.label: RELATED_TO
relations.description: A general, weaker relationship between two concepts that doesn't fit a more specific type above. Deliberate catch-all (curator's addition, not from discovery) so extraction doesn't silently drop true-but-unclassifiable prose relationships.
